name: Pinterest Pin Copy Generator (Blog Posts to Bulk CSV)

parameters.content:
## Pinterest Pin Copy Generator (Blog Posts to Bulk CSV)

### How it works

This workflow manually generates Pinterest pin copy from recent blog posts. It reads a configured RSS feed, selects the latest posts, sends them to an AI API for copy generation, then formats the results as a Pinterest bulk-upload CSV for download.

### Setup steps

- Open the ⚙️ Configure node and set the blog RSS feed URL in `feedUrl`.
- Set `postCount` to control how many recent posts are processed.
- Set `pinterestBoard` to the target board name used in the CSV output.
- Set `apiBaseUrl` to the AI copy-generation API endpoint base URL and configure any required HTTP authentication or headers in the AI request node.
- Run the workflow manually from the Run It node and download the generated CSV from the final node.

### Customization

Adjust the code in Take Latest Posts to change post filtering or ordering, and update Shape CSV Rows if your Pinterest CSV template needs different columns or formatting.

## Start and configure

Manual launch and workflow settings are defined here, including the RSS feed URL, number of posts to process, Pinterest board, and AI API base URL.

## Read latest posts

Fetches the configured blog RSS feed and narrows the results to the newest configured number of posts.

## Generate pin copy

Sends each selected blog post to the configured AI endpoint to create Pinterest-ready pin copy.

## Export bulk CSV

Parses the AI response into Pinterest bulk-upload rows and converts the shaped data into a downloadable CSV file.
